transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. I'm here because I've been struggling with an intense, overwhelming fear of riding in elevators. It has become increasingly difficult to manage, so I decided it was time to seek some help.
Does this fear cause you to avoid elevators completely, or do you endure them with intense anxiety?

Honestly, I do both. I actively avoid them whenever possible, even if it means walking up many flights of stairs instead. But if I absolutely have to use one, I just have to endure it with intense, overwhelming anxiety the entire time.
How long have you experienced this fear of elevators?
I've been dealing with this intense fear of elevators for about six months now. It has been a constant struggle ever since it started around that time.

The symptoms have been present for six months, meeting the duration criterion. There is no indication of other psychiatric symptoms such as mood episodes, trauma history outside the phobia, compulsions, or psychotic features. Therefore, Specific Phobia remains the most appropriate diagnosis at this time.
